findings.title: OME-Zarr 0.5 is conventions on Zarr v3; all Zarr features allowed unless disallowed
conditions: unless explicitly disallowed (no such disallowance in capture)

findings.title: Metadata in zarr.json under attributes.ome; version string MUST be hierarchy-consistent
RFC2119 keywords; examples/notes non-normative
Transitional metadata policy: read-side MUST/SHOULD possible, write MAY, removal intended
conditions: applies to bioformats2raw.layout and omero in this capture

findings.title: Document status: released 0.5; editor's-draft data not necessarily supported; version history 0.5.0-0.5.2
Image = Zarr group; levels = sibling arrays with arbitrary names; ordering from multiscales datasets, high-to-low resolution
2-5 dimensions; axis names arbitrary; axes length MUST equal array dims; type ordering time, channel/custom, space
axes: name MUST (unique); type SHOULD; unit SHOULD (UDUNITS-2 lists)
dimension_names MUST be in level-array zarr.json and MUST match axes names
multiscales MUSTs: axes, datasets, path, coordinateTransformations with exactly one scale; MAY one translation after scale; lengths MUST equal axes
Group-level coordinateTransformations MAY; applied after dataset-level; same type/order rules
Multiple multiscales entries: use single; else user choice by name, first fallback (informative pseudocode)
bioformats2raw.layout discovery: value MUST be 3; OME/series MUST be string paths matching OME-XML Image order; else numbered groups from 0
conditions: branch depends on presence of plate / series / neither

findings.title: Readers SHOULD surface multi-image collections; SHOULD NOT default to first image; MAY use series / show all / ignore other groups
HCS hierarchy MUST: plate/row/well groups above images; images in a well are fields of view; empty rows/wells SHOULD NOT be present
plate metadata MUST columns/rows/version/wells; SHOULD field_count, name; MAY acquisitions; name uniqueness/case rules; sparse plates supported
well metadata MUST images list (path rules; acquisition key MUST with multiple acquisitions); SHOULD version
plate key takes precedence over bioformats2raw.layout; mixing not possible; images MUST be at plate-defined locations
conditions: applies when top-level group is a plate

findings.title: Format is storage-location agnostic (local/HTTP/object storage); local-only is a product boundary
omero optional/transitional; MUSTs when present: channels, color (6-hex RGB), window min/max/start/end; rdefs example-only
conditions: omero optional; rdefs non-normative example; semantics delegated to OMERO WebGateway docs

findings.title: coordinateTransformations types closed: identity/translation/scale; list-of-floats or path (binary in container); applied sequentially in order
conditions: path variant layout unelaborated in capture (U-05)

findings.title: Calibration: exactly-one scale = pixel size/time duration; fallback relative factor defaulting 1.0; translation after scale; group-level applied after dataset-level
conditions: axes without scaling info carry relative factors

findings.title: Units are SHOULD-level; conforming files can lack units entirely
Spatial axes SHOULD be ordered zyx for anisotropic 3D stacks
labels group constraints: integer pixel types MUST; labels key MUST; intermediate groups MUST NOT contain metadata; label image MUST multiscales with equal level count
conditions: all label images SHOULD be listed

findings.title: image-label SHOULD present; colors array (MUST) with label-value (MUST) and rgba (MAY, 4 ints 0-255, 4th alpha); readers SHOULD honor colors; properties/source MAY
Label-image geometry compatibility soft: dims same or 1 (diagram, SHOULD-level); same coordinate system 'usually'; only level-count equality is MUST
Spec examples contain JSON comments; comments MUST NOT appear in real JSON
camelCase naming style with acknowledged exceptions; keys must be taken literally (maximumfieldcount vs field_count observed)
multiscales/axes/datasets obligations identical across all discovery branches
No codec/chunk-size/compression requirement for image arrays within S003
conditions: scoped to S003 full sequential read, 2026-10-01
